executiveSummary: This period saw disruptive law-enforcement and platform actions against AI-enabled criminal operations alongside continued large-scale fraud and impersonation campaigns. Microsoft and UK authorities dismantled the "EvilTokens" phishing-as-a-service platform, which reportedly compromised more than 12,000 Microsoft accounts across over 10,000 organizations, with two suspects arrested in the UK. View Article Supporting Report U.S. authorities also moved against illicit marketplaces and abuse infrastructure, including sanctions and seizures linked to a platform selling deepfake technology among broader cybercrime services, and domain seizures targeting non-consensual synthetic sexual content sites. View Article Supporting Report Operationally, AI-assisted financial fraud continues at scale, with over one million AI-tailored invoice scam emails observed by Microsoft researchers, and U.S. Treasury and FinCEN urging financial institutions to improve reporting and detection for cyber-enabled scams. View Article Supporting Report Voice cloning remains a frontline threat, with police dismantling an extortion ring in Greece and a reported $66,000 real-estate loss in Michigan tied to voice impersonation and spoofing tradecraft. View Article Supporting Report Election and platform governance advanced with Brazil's electoral authority establishing deepfake criteria for the 2026 cycle, Meta ordered to remove specific deepfakes in the UK, and Anthropic reporting the disruption of a Malaysia-focused manipulation campaign. View Article Supporting Report Supporting Report Defensive posture also benefited from updated NIST guidance and forensic initiatives. Security Advisory Supporting Report Overall, the threat environment is assessed as worsening due to concurrent growth in AI-enabled phishing, voice-clone extortion, executive impersonation, and cross-border manipulation, despite notable enforcement successes. incidents.title: Microsoft-backed takedown of "EvilTokens" PhaaS after 12,000+ Microsoft accounts compromised
incidents.summary: A phishing-as-a-service platform, "EvilTokens," used AI to customize lures and analyze inboxes, reportedly compromising over 12,000 Microsoft accounts across more than 10,000 organizations before Microsoft-led disruption. UK authorities arrested two suspects linked to the platform.

incidents.title: U.S. disrupts illicit marketplace offering deepfake tools among cybercrime services
incidents.summary: U.S. authorities sanctioned and disrupted an illicit marketplace that facilitated cybercrime, including sales of deepfake technology, and seized related wallets and Telegram infrastructure.

incidents.title: AI-tailored invoice scams scale executive impersonation and payment fraud
incidents.summary: Microsoft researchers observed more than one million AI-tailored invoice scam emails impersonating executives to solicit fraudulent payments.

incidents.title: Treasury and FinCEN urge enhanced reporting for large-scale cyber-enabled scams
incidents.summary: U.S. Treasury and FinCEN warned financial institutions about extensive scam ecosystems exploiting emerging technologies, urging improved reporting and detection.

incidents.title: Anthropic disrupts Malaysia-focused election manipulation operation
incidents.summary: A coordinated operation used fake social accounts, a fabricated news site, and defamation content to target voters; Anthropic reported disrupting the activity.

incidents.title: WaterPlum scheme: Job-seeker deception tied to AI/blockchain employer impersonation
incidents.summary: A multinational advisory described a large campaign posing as AI or blockchain companies to deceive job seekers, leading to device compromise, credential theft, and cryptocurrency losses.

incidents.title: New York seizes 12 domains tied to non-consensual celebrity deepfakes
incidents.summary: Prosecutors seized a dozen domains used to publish and sell celebrity deepfake content, signaling strengthened enforcement against non-consensual synthetic sexual imagery infrastructure.

incidents.title: Meta ordered to remove deepfakes; safeguards ruled inadequate in UK case
incidents.summary: Meta was ordered to remove specific harmful deepfakes, including political and identity-targeted content, amid criticism that platform safeguards and labeling were inadequate.

incidents.title: Police in Greece bust organized ring using AI voice cloning for cash extortion
incidents.summary: An organized fraud ring used AI-cloned voices to impersonate victims' relatives, coercing cash handovers before police dismantled the operation.

incidents.title: FBI IC3 reporting confirms material losses from AI-enabled scams including voice cloning
incidents.summary: FBI data documents significant victim losses tied to AI-enabled scams, including voice cloning, impacting individuals, families, and businesses.

incidents.title: Brazil's electoral authority sets deepfake criteria and election rules for 2026
incidents.summary: Brazil's electoral authority established binding criteria for identifying deepfakes and clarified election rules regarding synthetic content.

incidents.title: Michigan real-estate voice-clone scam leads to reported $66,000 loss
incidents.summary: Homebuyers reportedly lost $66,000 after scammers impersonated a trusted mortgage contact using voice cloning, spoofed email, and caller-ID deception.

incidents.title: Audio deepfake detection via temporal coherence analysis (research preprint)
incidents.summary: Proposed method aims to detect AI-generated audio by analyzing temporal coherence, potentially aiding identification of voice-cloning artifacts.

incidents.title: Iran-linked operation used fake MRI documents to deliver malware
incidents.summary: Campaign delivered malware and stole credentials using fabricated MRI scan results to build trust with targets.

Payments: Require multi-person approvals, positive pay, and hold periods for first-time beneficiaries; log and review wire instruction changes. Analyst Recommendation
Recruiting security: Vet employer domains, use secure file exchange for candidate tests, and sandbox all attachments. Analyst Recommendation
Provenance: Pilot C2PA-signing for official media; preserve originals to retain watermark/provenance signals for forensic analysis. Analyst Recommendation
Forensics: Validate detection tools against NIST benchmarks; document tool versions/parameters in case files. Analyst Recommendation
Election readiness: Pre-establish rapid triage cells, platform liaisons, and legal review for suspected deepfakes consistent with national criteria. Analyst Recommendation
